entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wassup.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Mm...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wh-What? Why're you starin' at my face?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ryuji—I have a favor to ask.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A favor? Sure, you need some money[n]for food or somethi—

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Not this time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I've actually been mulling over a new[n]battle tactic for a while now...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And I'd like for you to lend a hand in[n]bringing my idea to fruition.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ooh, a new move...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That sounds badass! I totally want in!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, it's merely a rough idea at this[n]point, but...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What do you think?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wasn't that, like... way more detailed[n]than some rough idea?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ha—I don't deserve such praise...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I would merely prefer to add a splash of[n]beauty to an otherwise barbaric[n]battlefield, so to speak.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sick!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, all we gotta do now is see how the[n]Star reacts to your idea, right?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We should consult Jose about this soon.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, I can feel my appetite[n]growing after describing my idea...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Same here.
